# Lab 2.5: Schema Evolution

## What We Are Going to Do
Change a table's schema safely: add a column, relax a required column, rename, change a type, and drop a column.

## Steps

1. **[Console] Add a column.** Open `lab02.customers_ui → Schema → Edit schema → Add field`. Add `email STRING`. Click **Save**.

2. **[SQL] Make more changes.**

ALTER TABLE lab02.customers_ui ALTER COLUMN customer_id DROP NOT NULL;
ALTER TABLE lab02.customers_ui RENAME COLUMN signup_date TO joined_on;

3. **[SQL] Widen a type and drop a column.**

<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • SQL
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">ALTER TABLE lab02.type_demo ALTER COLUMN price SET DATA TYPE NUMERIC(12, 2);
ALTER TABLE lab02.type_demo DROP COLUMN photo;</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


   Widening is allowed (for example, INT64 to NUMERIC, or NUMERIC(10,2) to NUMERIC(12,2)). Narrowing is not.

5. **[SQL] Try a change that is not allowed.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • SQL
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">ALTER TABLE lab02.type_demo ALTER COLUMN name SET DATA TYPE INT64;</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


   This fails. STRING to INT64 is not a safe change. The fix is to create a new table with `CREATE TABLE … AS SELECT SAFE_CAST(…)`.

## Expected Result

| Thing | Reality |
|---|---|
| Add column | Always allowed, new column is NULLABLE |
| REQUIRED to NULLABLE | Allowed; NULLABLE to REQUIRED is not |
| Rename / drop | Allowed with DDL |
| Narrowing types | Rejected |
